subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Where a feature is draft-born, the system shall let the PRD reviewer and the tech-spec reviewer take its draft's PRD and tech spec as subjects in any round, in place of prd:prd-review/FR-1, prd:prd-review/FR-13, and prd:tech-design-review/FR-1.
rationale: This contract overrides the reviewer subject rows for draft-born features (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-15)
fit_criterion: Both reviewers complete a verdict on a fixture draft's PRD and tech spec, and each report is stored as a review document in the draft (FR-4).
